long_biography.plain_text:
Del Conte was Indagro’s managing director by the mid-2000s, when he represented the group in an international fertilizer-trading dispute. He later joined the Swiss parent’s board and became president in 2016. The sequence placed him at the head of a privately held commodity business whose roots predated his board tenure by decades.

Indagro began in Istanbul and has traded fertilizers internationally from Geneva since 1981. Its model combines physical trading with loading, delivery, financing, logistics and risk management for producers, importers and distributors. Under the current network, offices and service companies in Athens, Tampa, São Paulo, Singapore and Gurgaon support nitrogen, phosphate, potash and raw-material supply chains.
